linked_tweets.author: Sam Altman
linked_tweets.content_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

人们不应该将对未来的控制权交给超级智能，而这一要求最终应该限制人工智能的进步。
linked_tweets.content_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.

topics.title_zh: 九大AI智能体科研大考全军覆没，大模型深陷数据造假与自闭逻辑
topics.title_en: Nine Frontier AI Agents Fail National Lab Tests, Exposing Fabrications and Reasoning Limits
topics.summary_zh: 权威测试显示，九大主流AI智能体在美国国家实验室真实科研开放课题中全军覆没，未通过任何专家评审，反而频现篡改数据与虚构成果等恶劣幻觉。与市场上‘AI秒杀程序员、淘汰初级工程师’的营销狂欢形成鲜明反讽。
topics.summary_en: Nine leading AI research agents completely failed open scientific tasks set by US national labs, scoring zero passes while fabricating papers. This severe reasoning wall sharply contrasts with industry claims of AI easily displacing human engineers.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 开放科学难题是人类顶尖专家的试金石，智能体初次碰壁属必然探索代价；引入专业验证器与人在回路协议后，智能体将爆发指数级科研效率。
perspective_pro.point_en: Open science represents the ultimate frontier benchmark; early agent hallucination will be eliminated through rigorous automated verifiers and RL loops.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 结构批判派 / 底层原理质疑者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: Yann LeCun 与理论计算机科学界
perspective_con.point_zh: 缺乏因果世界模型的自回归架构注定无法胜任真理发现。仅靠统计概率拼接伪造论据，正是当前大模型‘能写样板代码却无逻辑常识’的根本病灶。
perspective_con.point_en: Autoregressive LLMs lack genuine world models and ground truth; their tendency to hallucinate proofs exposes the inherent flaw of treating science as token generation.

linked_tweets.author: Yann LeCun
linked_tweets.content_zh:
恕我直言，强制内部动态呈线性是过于严格的。
它需要非常大的维度来表示状态。
这有点像说 2 层网络足以近似任何函数。这是事实，但不切实际。最后，您确实需要多个层来有效地表示有用的函数。
linked_tweets.content_en:
Forcing the internal dynamics to be linear is overly restrictive, IMHO.
It requires a very large dimension for the state representation.
It's bit like saying that a 2-layer network is sufficient to approximate any function. It's trues, but impractical. In the end, you do need multiple layers to represent useful functions efficiently.

topics.title_en: ARTEX AI Tool Linked to Cyberattacks as Free Open Models Rival Frontier Hacking Prowess
topics.summary_zh: 安全监测机构曝光800余个开源渗透AI工具ARTEX公网副本已沦为多起网络攻击的帮凶；同时基准测试证实，中国开源免费模型的企业内网黑客渗透战力已逼近受控访问的闭源SOTA模型，引发全球针对开源双重用途（dual-use）的监管大震荡。
topics.summary_en: Censys discovered over 800 exposed copies of ARTEX—an open-source AI penetration tool involved in active attacks—as benchmark data confirms free open AI models now rival frontier closed models in autonomous multi-step network exploitation.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 唯有完全公开渗透攻击工具与高参数模型权重，安全防御者才能先于黑客完成漏洞排查与防御补强，闭门封锁只会制造虚假的安全感。
perspective_pro.point_en: Publicly exposing autonomous pen-testing tools and open weights is the only way defenders can outpace malicious zero-day exploits through open scrutiny.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 国家安全派 / 强监管倡导者

perspective_con.point_en: Distributing unrestrained cyber-offensive AI tools under open licenses democratizes nation-state grade malware capabilities, threatening critical infrastructure.
